**The Aldous property for normal Cayley graphs on symmetric groups**

*Chenhui Lv∗1 and Sanming Zhou 2*

23 pp, 12 sections.

**Abstract.** Aldous’ spectral gap conjecture states that the random walk and the interchange process on any connected graph have the same spectral gap, or, equivalently, the second largest eigenvalue of any connected Cayley graph on the symmetric groupS n with respect to a set of transpositions is achieved by the standard representation ofS n. This celebrated conjecture, proved in its general form in 2010, has inspired much interest in searching for other Cayley graphs onS n possessing this property, now known as the Aldous property. In this paper, we first prove that forn≥5 at most one of a normal Cayley graph onSn and its complement can possess the Aldous property except when these two graphs are 2K n!/2 andK n!/2,n!/2 respectively.
